<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>NSE IPO adjustment:</strong> The National Stock Exchange has downsized its upcoming IPO to Rs 23,000 crore, with key shareholders reducing their offer-for-sale (OFS) portion by over 15% amid mounting valuation concerns.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Crude oil volatility:</strong> Brent crude prices have climbed above $105 per barrel following the Houthi seizure of Mokha Port, posing a significant inflationary risk for the Indian economy and domestic markets.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Fintech regulatory shift:</strong> RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra has mandated that fintech firms treat consumer data as a fiduciary duty rather than a business asset, signaling a tighter regulatory environment for the sector.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
</ul>
